notes.title: Forgotten Hill The Third Axis is available on Steam!
notes.notes:
TL;DR: Forgotten Hill The Third Axis, our first 3D game, is now available on Steam for Pc and Mac for free!

[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2618920/Forgotten_Hill_The_Third_Axis/][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42074650/87ab5805e0b13f1b50d856c0499e153846544628.png[/img][/url]

A bit longer story: when we first released The Third Axis on the web and mobile our plan were to add more chapters to this first story and when the we would have enough chapter or the story will be completed, we would have released a long complete game on Steam. That's basically what we did for [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1926170/Forgotten_Hill_Tales/]Forgotten Hill Tales[/url] and what is happening with Forgotten Hill The Wardrobe.

But then, one September day that at first seemed the same as all the others, some Unity guys (Unity is the engine we used to develop the game) decided they are entitled to change the rules of the market and break the trust developer put in them. 
You probably all know the story (if not there's a good recap [url=https://www.pocketgamer.biz/news/82437/the-unity-runtime-fee-farago-the-whole-story-all-in-one-place/]here[/url]), a few days later they changed their mind, they said they are not going to change terms retroactively anymore, the mind behind this [i]"retired"[/i], but still we cannot feel too relieved. At this time we can't afford to invest our time and efforts using a tool owned by people we don't trust.
Would this mean the Third Axis ends here? Not at all, we still want to go on and make more chapters as we still have a lot of things to tell, but we need to make some decision (first is which engine will we move to?) so in the meantime enjoy the first chapter of Forgotten Hill The Third Axis, and let us know what you think!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2618920/Forgotten_Hill_The_Third_Axis/

notes.title: Forgotten Hill Disillusion is coming
notes.notes:
Hi guys,
we can finally announce the Official Release Date for Forgotten Hill Disillusion, the newest installment of Forgotten Hill games series. 

You will act as Mr. Larson and explore the evil that lurks inside the Museum of Forgotten Hill starting from November 20, 2019.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32081693/9e5347f2b591f84a758c299901e3b991523ac12d.png[/img]

Demo version, including the first section of the museum, is already available, get it now.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1133930/Forgotten_Hill_Disillusion/

notes.title: New game coming soon!
notes.notes:
It's been more than a year since we released Forgotten Hill Mementoes but we haven't been sitting on our hands all this time.

We've worked a lot on the fourth chapter of Forgotten Hill main story and we are proud to announce that [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1133930/Forgotten_Hill_Disillusion/][b]Forgotten Hill Disillusion[/b][/url] is coming this fall!

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32081693/33c5ed3ba56b3fe48082c27061892ff16dc1b33e.png[/img]

In this new adventure you will step again into [i]Mr. Larson's[/i] shoes and find yourself in the disturbing Museum of Forgotten Hill, where you will explore more than 50 different locations to unveil the mystery of Forgotten Hill and escape its horrors.

Stay tuned for any news and don't forget to add [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1133930/Forgotten_Hill_Disillusion/]Forgotten Hill Disillusion to your wishlist[/url]!

notes.notes:

Are you ready to go on a dark journey across the memories of Forgotten Hill?
